incentives.description: $1/Day when imports are 0.03 kWh/hour or less, between 6pm-9pm (Local Time).

demandCharges.description: A demand charge applies in addition to your usage and daily supply charges. It is based on your highest kW demand in any half hour period between 3pm and 9pm on any day during Summer (1 November to 31 March) and Winter (1 June to 31 August), and resets monthly. The charge is applied in cents per kW per day across your billing period. No demand charge applies outside these months. Demand charges are not included in the estimated annual cost shown.
